name: aiyou-desktop
description: AIYOU is a Codex Harness desktop workspace with native multi-provider multimodal model access.
author: AIYOU

scripts.build:electron: tsup src/main/main.ts src/preload/preload.ts --format cjs --platform node --out-dir dist-electron --external electron --clean
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.capture: npm run build && cross-env AIYOU_CAPTURE_VIEW=main electron . --capture-ui artifacts/ui-main.png
scripts.capture:settings: npm run build && cross-env AIYOU_CAPTURE_VIEW=settings electron . --capture-ui artifacts/ui-settings.png
scripts.capture:models: npm run build && cross-env AIYOU_CAPTURE_VIEW=models electron . --capture-ui artifacts/ui-model-workbench.png
scripts.capture:streaming: npm run build && cross-env AIYOU_CAPTURE_VIEW=streaming electron . --capture-ui artifacts/ui-streaming-chat.png
scripts.capture:defaults: npm run build && cross-env AIYOU_CAPTURE_VIEW=defaults electron . --capture-ui artifacts/ui-default-models.png
scripts.capture:plugins: npm run build && cross-env AIYOU_CAPTURE_VIEW=plugins electron . --capture-ui artifacts/ui-plugin-workspace.png
scripts.capture:skills: npm run build && cross-env AIYOU_CAPTURE_VIEW=skills electron . --capture-ui artifacts/ui-skills-runtime-v0.3.2.png
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 -c.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist
